reasoning: Bitwise arithmetic: `(hi << 8) | lo` with operands swapped; mutants of the edited `lo | (hi << 8)` replace `|` with `&` and `<<` with `>>`, as cargo-mutants does. The `^` replacement is omitted because the two operands never share a bit, so it is equivalent. The exact pin pack(0x12, 0x34) == 0x1234 fails on both. 2 of 2 listed mutants fail cargo test. No RIPR spec defines a bitwise-operator cell.
